slides.title: UN releases emergency funds for Moyale displaced
from the UN's emergency fund, CERF
slides.body: UN relief chief Tom Fletcher announced the allocation on Nov 6 for aid operations in northern Kenya.

slides.title: people fled southern Ethiopia into Kenya
slides.body: Most are in Moyale Sub-County, Marsabit, staying with host communities. Women and children are the majority.

slides.title: sought by four UN agencies
slides.body: UNHCR, UNICEF, IOM and WFP appealed on Nov 5 to help up to 50,000 people for three months.

slides.title: Ethiopian side remains volatile
slides.body: OCHA says security on the Ethiopian side of Moyale is still volatile. New arrivals describe widespread destruction of homes.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Fund aid for displaced families.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
